# stackcone

> stackcone builds production RAG chatbots and AI agents (LangGraph, MCP, evals, citations), plus Python full-stack, data engineering, and Flutter. Founded by Amar Kumar. Fixed scope, full handover.

## About

stackcone is an AI engineering studio founded by Amar Kumar (AI & Python engineer, 10+ years). Hire on Upwork: https://www.upwork.com/agencies/2022687811186513260/ · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/stackcone/

## Services

- AI agent development and AI automation for business (custom AI agents, AI customer support agents, AI voice agents / AI receptionists, MCP server development) for US, UK and EU clients
- Production RAG and agentic RAG (vector search, embeddings, evaluation)
- MCP / LangGraph tool workflows with human-in-the-loop governance
- Support copilots and document intelligence
- Python full-stack web development (FastAPI, Django, React, Next.js, APIs)
- Flutter mobile apps (iOS and Android)
- Data engineering and data platform migration (ETL, streaming, warehouses, dbt)
- Cloud and DevOps (AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, CI/CD) with regional residency options

## Delivery

- Remote-first with overlapping hours across time zones
- Fixed scope, milestones, and full handover (code, runbooks, docs)
- Privacy-aware design; we do not claim certifications we do not hold

## Learn (free courses)

Free interactive lessons with in-browser code runners: https://stackcone.com/learn/

- [Python](https://stackcone.com/learn/programming/python/hello-world/): 21 lessons. From your first print() to classes, files, and exceptions.
- [Java](https://stackcone.com/learn/programming/java/hello-world/): 20 lessons. Static typing, OOP, and the collections you use every day.
- [JavaScript](https://stackcone.com/learn/programming/javascript/hello-world/): 15 lessons. The language of the web: values, functions, arrays, async code and the DOM.
- [HTML & CSS](https://stackcone.com/learn/programming/htmlcss/introduction/): 13 lessons. Structure pages with HTML and style them with modern CSS, Flexbox and Grid.
- [TypeScript](https://stackcone.com/learn/programming/typescript/introduction/): 12 lessons. Add static types to JavaScript: interfaces, generics and safer code.
- [Git & Command Line](https://stackcone.com/learn/programming/git/command-line/): 12 lessons. Move around the terminal and track work with Git branches and pull requests.
- [Docker](https://stackcone.com/learn/programming/docker/introduction/): 11 lessons. Package apps into containers and run multi-service stacks with Compose.
- [Pandas](https://stackcone.com/learn/programming/pandas/introduction/): 12 lessons. Analyze tabular data in Python: loading, cleaning, grouping and merging.
- [SQL](https://stackcone.com/learn/programming/sql/introduction/): 17 lessons. Query, filter, join and aggregate data in relational databases.
- [Data Structures](https://stackcone.com/learn/ds-algo/data-structures/introduction/): 16 lessons. Arrays, lists, trees, graphs, and why Big O matters.
- [Algorithms](https://stackcone.com/learn/ds-algo/algorithms/searching/): 17 lessons. Searching, sorting, recursion, greedy, backtracking and dynamic programming.
- [System Design](https://stackcone.com/learn/ds-algo/sysdesign/fundamentals/): 18 lessons. Scalability, caching, databases, queues and how to design real systems.
- [AI (Artificial Intelligence)](https://stackcone.com/learn/ai/artificial-intelligence/what-is-an-llm/): 20 lessons. LLMs, tokens, prompts, embeddings, vector search, BM25, hybrid search, RAG, agents, harnesses, LangGraph, streaming and interview prep. Beginner to expert, in one place.
- [AI Interview Questions](https://stackcone.com/learn/ai/interview-questions/ai-ml-fundamentals/): 10 lessons. 110 commonly asked AI, ML, LLM, RAG and agent interview questions with detailed model answers, diagrams and code. Built for big-tech style loops.
- [LangChain](https://stackcone.com/learn/frameworks/langchain/introduction/): 15 lessons. Build LLM apps: prompts, chains, retrieval (RAG) and tool-using agents.
- [React](https://stackcone.com/learn/frameworks/react/introduction/): 15 lessons. Components, state, effects, forms and data fetching with modern hooks.
- [Next.js](https://stackcone.com/learn/frameworks/nextjs/introduction/): 15 lessons. Full-stack React: file-based routing, server components and API routes.
- [FastAPI](https://stackcone.com/learn/frameworks/fastapi/introduction/): 15 lessons. Typed, fast Python APIs with validation and automatic docs.
- [Django](https://stackcone.com/learn/frameworks/django/introduction/): 15 lessons. Models, views, templates and the admin in Python's batteries-included framework.
- [Spring Boot](https://stackcone.com/learn/frameworks/spring/introduction/): 15 lessons. Java REST APIs with dependency injection, JPA and validation.
- [Flask](https://stackcone.com/learn/frameworks/flask/introduction/): 15 lessons. Lightweight Python web apps and APIs with routes, templates and blueprints.
- [Express](https://stackcone.com/learn/frameworks/express/introduction/): 15 lessons. Routes, middleware and REST APIs on Node.js.
